subject: BUG-260 (CRITICAL): 4 labs have NO flag_registry entry, so every flag capture is silently rejected server-side
description:
Found 2026-09-05 by widening the ctf-boxes gate while fixing BUG-257. The four: houses/matrix/adv-linux/labs/ala-hunt1-website-down, ala-hunt2-perimeter-open, ala-hunt3-lost-authority, and houses/shield/infosec/labs/pis-m2-vault-breach. Each declares a registryId and calls awardFlag(), which reaches the validateAction Cloud Function, which does 'const registryDoc = await db.doc(flag_registry/{boxId}).get(); if (!registryDoc.exists) throw new HttpsError(not-found, Lab not registered.)' at functions/index.js:~3939. BoxEngine.awardFlag swallows that rejection deliberately: '.catch(() => {}); // silent - don't block gameplay' (BoxEngine.js ~1723). So a student completes the objective, the badge turns green locally, and NOTHING is recorded server-side. This is EXACTLY the ops-05-operation-blackwire failure the ctf-boxes validator was written for in 2026-08-05: 'shipped to students fully built, listed in the arena, and completely unsolvable... found by hand, months late, by a cross-reference nothing ran.' WHY IT WAS INVISIBLE: the validator's scan was two hardcoded arena directories while post-verify printed 'every box on disk has its flags registered'. All four of these live under _app/houses/, which it never looked at. The claim was wider than the scan. NOW FIXED: the validator discovers by SHAPE (any config.js declaring a registryId, anywhere under _app/houses) rather than by hardcoded location, keyed on the DECLARED registryId rather than the directory name so a lab whose folder and id differ is checked against the right document. Discovery went from 150 boxes to 284. NEXT STEP: seed flag_registry for the four, or confirm they are intentionally unlisted and remove them from their hubs. Until then the gate exits 1 and will flag divergence on the next deploy, which is the gate working, not a regression.
[2026-09-05 21:16] RESOLVED. 32 flags seeded across the 4 labs via seed-box-flags.js --only (one box at a time, 242 others untouched). Values extracted programmatically from each config and verified verbatim. Gate re-run against the LIVE registry: exit 0, all four BOX-001 gone. Validator now discovers by shape (registryId anywhere under _app/houses), coverage 150 -> 284 boxes.
